entries.08ef942d1724fc92: It operates “Gyomu Super” stores and guides and manages sub-FCs within franchise areas. Under a contract with franchisor Kobe Bussan, it operates in Niigata, Fukushima, Miyagi, Ibaraki, Gunma, Yamagata, Nagano, Toyama, Akita, Hokkaido and Kumamoto, and consolidated subsidiary Kawasaki operates stores as a sub-franchisee. The number of directly operated stores of the company group at the end of the current period is 80. Revenue from external customers is ¥52,267 million (fiscal year ended March 2026).

entries.7ac60857a421b487: The reportable segments are five: the Supermarket Business, the Gyomu Super Business, the Bento and Meal Service Business, the Food Delivery Business, and Ryokan and Other Businesses. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥52,267 million for the Gyomu Super Business, the largest, ¥27,472 million for the Supermarket Business, ¥10,828 million for the Bento and Meal Service Business, ¥4,960 million for the Food Delivery Business, and ¥526 million for Ryokan and Other Businesses. By region, there are no sales to external customers outside Japan, and no customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
entries.7b149dcf07b83f65: The company is headquartered in Sanjo, Niigata Prefecture, and forms a group together with its two consolidated subsidiaries, Thank You All Japan and Kawasaki. The number of consolidated employees is 1,029 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.8426f62a86502d8e: Under the “Yoshikei” brand, it delivers dinner ingredient sets and similar products. Under a franchise agreement with Yoshikei Kaihatsu, it operates across all of Niigata, Gunma and Hokkaido and part of Tochigi Prefecture. Revenue from external customers is ¥4,960 million (fiscal year ended March 2026).
entries.8e0e8b4df4d6cfba: The company is pursuing its medium-term management plan, 'Creating New Value with IDEA & INNOVATION', covering the three years from Reiwa 6 to Reiwa 8. Its policy is to deepen collaboration among its business divisions, combine physical stores with online operations, and improve employee satisfaction as well as secure and develop personnel. It aims to expand the Supermarket Business, the Gyomu Super Business and the Bento and Meal Service Business, and to widen its store areas through synergies between directly operated stores and sub-FC stores.
entries.90985c804fcd6123: Under brands such as “Fresh Lunch 39,” it manufactures and sells corporate delivery bento, undertakes contract manufacturing of side dishes and other prepared foods, and operates in-company cafeterias on commission. Consolidated subsidiary Sankyū Ōru Japan operates the franchise expansion of “Fresh Lunch 39.” Revenue from external customers is ¥10,828 million (fiscal year ended March 2026).

entries.cbd0591a54178b8c: Under its philosophy of 'better products at lower prices', its basic policy is to pass on savings in product procurement costs to customers. It operates five businesses under a divisional system: the Supermarket Business, the Gyomu Super Business, the Bento and Meal Service Business, the Food Delivery Business and the Ryokan Business. It expands its store areas through brand development under franchise agreements and a combination of directly operated stores and sub-FC stores.
